'''2011 Worlds Day 2 K. Brown LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[K. Brown]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Typed sheet. Start Plead My Case / Sanity & Compassion as written; Coruscant (ep1) → Coruscant; shield 1 Weapons Display crossed out → Planetary Defenses (V); line 60 Anger, Fear, Agression spelling on sheet → Anger, Fear, Aggression (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion]]
* '''Username:''' danjedknight71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
